description: Historical incidents for the deterministic troubleshooting environment.

incidents.title: Expired service-account token caused order creation failures
incidents.root_cause: A batch client continued using an expired OAuth access token.
incidents.resolution: The client refreshed the token and added proactive renewal.

incidents.title: Deployment lost orders:write scope
incidents.resolution: The client configuration was corrected and new tokens were issued.

incidents.title: Payment Service degradation caused gateway failures
incidents.root_cause: Payment Service returned HTTP 500 during authorization.
incidents.resolution: Payment Service rolled back a faulty release.

incidents.title: Payment authorization latency exceeded timeout
incidents.root_cause: Payment Service latency exceeded the 3000 ms timeout.
incidents.resolution: A slow Payment Service database query was optimized.

incidents.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
incidents.root_cause: A connection leak exhausted the Order Service database pool.
incidents.resolution: The leak was fixed and affected instances were recycled.

incidents.title: Retry storm triggered client rate limiting
incidents.root_cause: A client retried without backoff and exceeded its quota.
incidents.resolution: The client implemented bounded backoff with jitter and honored Retry-After.
